items.title: File Widerspruch against Fahrtenbuchauflage
items.quote: Der Widerspruch muss binnen eines Monats, nachdem Ihnen der Bescheid bekannt gegeben worden ist, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift beim Kreis Beispielförde, Kreishaus, Förder Straße 3, 24103 Beispielförde, erhoben werden.
items.computation: The notice is dated Tuesday 29.09.2026; assuming it was handed to the post on that date, the statutory delivery fiction for authority letters (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG / entsprechende Vorschrift des Landesverwaltungsgesetzes SH) deems it received on the third day after posting: 02.10.2026 (a Friday, a normal working day, so no weekend/holiday shift applies). The one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs 'nachdem bekannt gegeben worden ist', an Ereignisfrist under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe (02.10.2026) itself is not counted, the period starts 03.10.2026, and per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number as the day of the triggering event, i.e. 02.11.2026 (a Monday). Neither 01.11. (Allerheiligen, not a holiday in Schleswig-Holstein) nor 02.11. is a Saturday, Sunday or SH public holiday, so § 193 BGB requires no shift.

items.title: Start/end of six-month Fahrtenbuch obligation (depends on finality of the order)
items.quote: Ich ordne daher an, dass Sie für dieses Fahrzeug für die Dauer von sechs Monaten ein Fahrtenbuch zu führen haben. Die Auflage beginnt mit Eintritt der Bestandskraft dieses Bescheids.
items.computation: The six-month duty to keep a logbook only begins once the order becomes 'bestandskräftig' (final/unappealable). If no Widerspruch is filed within the deadline computed above (which expires 02.11.2026), Bestandskraft would occur the following day, 03.11.2026 at the earliest, and the six-month period would then run until roughly 02.05.2027. If a Widerspruch is filed, Bestandskraft is postponed until that procedure (and any subsequent legal action) concludes, so no fixed start or end date can be given now.

warnings: The Widerspruch deadline was computed assuming the letter was posted on its printed date (29.09.2026); if it was actually mailed later, the deemed-delivery date and therefore the 02.11.2026 deadline shift accordingly — check the postmark/envelope if available.

The start and end dates of the six-month Fahrtenbuch obligation cannot be fixed yet because they depend on when the order becomes legally final (Bestandskraft), i.e. on whether a Widerspruch is filed and how it is resolved.
